605:t_000:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$... You mean $$アムブリエル$$ is coming?」

605:t_000:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Going by what she said when she left last time, this may be the final battle with that woman.」

605:t_000:7.en:
$n
(Just defeating her isn't enough. We have to rescue Miss $$スズネ$$ from inside her...)

605:t_000:8.en:
$n
(But... is that really the right thing to do...?)

605:t_000:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It seems the Empire doesn't want the truth of the Box made public either.」

605:t_000:10.en:
$$キラ$$
「You mean... it's not about the new humans' political participation, it's tied to $$クロノ$$'s doctrine, right?」

605:t_000:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is that right, Ensign $$リディ$$?」

605:t_000:13.en:
$$シン$$
「You've come this far and you're still going to keep quiet?」

605:t_000:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「The truth at the very bottom of $$ラプラスの箱$$... It's not something I should be the one to tell.」

605:t_000:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's probably set up to be disclosed when the true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter is spoken.」

605:t_000:17.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That must be the secret at the deepest part of the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$'s $$ヴェーダ$$... at Level 8...」

605:t_000:18.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is there some connection between the $$宇宙世紀$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ of the $$ＡＤＷ$$?」

605:t_000:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I hear $$サイアム・ビスト$$ spoke the names of $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ and $$エルガン・ローディック$$.」

605:t_000:20.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ was preparing to make the truth of $$ラプラスの箱$$ public to the whole world, so there's no doubt the two are connected.」

605:t_000:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「So we'll learn everything soon...」

605:t_001:0.en:
$$リディ$$
(The only question left is whether humanity can accept it...)

605:t_001:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「After all, I also carry the blood of $$リカルド・マーセナス$$, who stood against $$クロノ$$.」

605:t_001:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're you, $$リディ$$. $$クロノ$$ and your family have nothing to do with it.」

605:t_001:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Hearing you say that puts my mind a little more at ease.」

605:t_001:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$... Now that you've opened your heart, you can surely change.」

605:t_001:8.en:
$$リディ$$
(You saved both $$アルベルト$$ and me...)

605:t_001:9.en:
$$リディ$$
(So I'll protect you... and $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ$$... and humanity's future, too...)

605:t_001:11.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」

605:t_002:0.en:
$$リディ$$
(The only question left is whether humanity can accept it...)

605:t_002:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「After all, I also carry the blood of $$リカルド・マーセナス$$, who stood against $$クロノ$$.」

605:t_002:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're you, $$リディ$$. $$クロノ$$ and your family have nothing to do with it.」

605:t_002:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Hearing you say that puts my mind a little more at ease.」

605:t_002:6.en:
$$リディ$$
($$マリーダ$$... I swear I'll protect $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ$$...)

605:t_002:7.en:
$$リディ$$
(It's the only atonement I can make for taking your life.)

605:t_002:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」

605:t_003:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Impressive. Not only did you beat $$ネオ・ジオン$$, you even took $$バルビエル$$ down a peg.」

605:t_003:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「But thanks to you, $$バルビエル$$'s hatred will only grow stronger...」

605:t_003:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「To keep him from acting so big, I'll be taking $$ジェミニオン$$ back from you here.」

605:t_003:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, you uppity woman! Today we're getting Miss $$スズネ$$ back for sure!」

605:t_003:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Spare me the speeches. We don't have much time, so let's get started.」

605:t_003:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean to stop $$ラプラスの箱$$ from being made public!」

605:t_003:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Well, something like that.」

605:t_003:10.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「We may not have much time, but let's enjoy it, $c!」

605:t_003:11.en:
$n
「I have no intention of enjoying it.」

605:t_003:12.en:
$n
「Here I come, $$アムブリエル$$! I won't hand over $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ or Miss $$スズネ$$ to you!」

605:t_004:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ has broken into the $$地球圏$$'s communication systems!」

605:t_004:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「As long as the Empire's infrastructure is also Earth's existing one, they won't be able to shut it down easily.」

605:t_004:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Old man $$イオリア$$... Looks like he saw this day coming.」

605:t_004:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Transmission from $$メガラニカ$$ is starting!」

605:t_005:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Looks like it's started.」

605:t_005:2.en:
$n
「You mean to stop the broadcast by force?」

605:t_005:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Something like that. ...Personally, either way is fine with me.」

605:t_005:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Here I come, $n! Both I and the other one inside me are interested in you!」

605:t_007:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're the ones who lost.」

605:t_007:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Too bad. Even if you defeat me, your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ is never coming back!」

605:t_007:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's true. I can't feel her presence inside me anymore.」

605:t_007:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「But it's also a fact that I lost to you. I have no intention of living on in disgrace.」

605:t_007:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Heh heh... About time, I think.」

605:t_008:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You felt it too, $$バナージ$$!」

605:t_008:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A light of hatred... is coming!」
